map.自定义请求头会触发预检吗？: Do custom request headers trigger a preflight?
map.会。只有简单请求（GET/HEAD/POST + 少数安全头部 + 简单 Con: Yes. Only simple requests (GET/HEAD/POST with a handful of safe headers and a simple Content-Type) skip the preflight; as soon as you add a custom header (such as Authorization or X-Token) or use application/json, the browser sends an OPTIONS preflight first, and the real request is allowed only if the server responds correctly.
map.为什么有些请求头在 JS 里设不上？: Why can some request headers not be set from JS?
map.部分头部由浏览器保留控制，禁止脚本修改，例如 Host、Content-Leng: Some headers are reserved and controlled by the browser, so scripts cannot modify them: Host, Content-Length, Origin, Referer and anything beginning with Sec-. Setting them is silently ignored or throws; headers like these must be configured on the server or at the proxy.
